text: The Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on September 20, 2020 adopted a City staff recommendation to introduce turn prohibitions on Bloor Street West at Perth Avenue. In early March 2021, it was brought to my attention that the turn prohibitions did not reflect what had been requested by residents of the Junction Triangle neighbourhood. By way of re-opening this item, I am requesting that Traffic Operations staff amend the following prohibition.

City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council delete Part 2 of City Council's decision on TE18.78 and replace it with the following revised Part 2: 2. City Council prohibit eastbound left turns from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. Monday to Friday (bicycles excepted) from Bloor Street West to Perth Avenue.
